_comment: Every song the harmony panel offers, and the names she answers to. Adding a song is an entry here plus its folder; nothing in the code needs to change.
_dir_note: dir is the folder under source/harmony holding manifest.json, contours.json, lyrics.json, lyrics_en.txt and the part recordings. Lupang Hinirang has dir "" because its files sit directly in source/harmony, where the consoles on 5173 and 5174 still read them from — moving them would break those.
_ready_note: ready false means the song is listed but has no recordings yet: the panel shows it greyed out and she says she cannot sing it rather than starting something silent.
_aliases_note: How the song might be ASKED for, including what speech recognition tends to hear. Matched longest-first, so a two-word name wins over a one-word one it contains.

songs.title: Silent Night
songs._parts_note: All four parts recorded: they agree within 0.12s, and the opening notes make a B flat major chord - B flat in the bass, D in the alto, F in the soprano. The recording has three verses; ends_at stops it at the end of the second, which is a rest every part shares, so nothing is cut off mid-note. lyrics.json carries those two verses only.

songs.title: Bahay Kubo
songs._parts_note: Soprano C5 and alto E4, both as sung with nothing cut. They line up: 0.06s offset, every third of the song within 0.08s, 0.14s of drift. Sung lengths agree to 0.02s. The soprano is the quieter of the two at 0.14 against 0.20 - it arrived 12x under and its peak only allowed 5.6x back, short of the 9.4x it wanted. No phrase boundaries: the alto sustains through the soprano's breaths, so the two share no rest.

_ends_at_note: ends_at stops a song before its recording does, in seconds from the first sung note. Omit it and the take runs until the singer stops.
